claim: AI prompts for marketing produce generic copy because marketers prompt for adjectives instead of setting negative constraints.
hook: Why most AI prompts for marketing produce generic copy, and the three negative constraints that fix it.

reel_script.onscreen: Why your AI prompts sound generic
reel_script.voiceover: If your AI prompts for marketing produce generic brand copy, you are giving it adjectives instead of negative constraints.
reel_script.direction: Rachit talking directly to camera in office setting.

reel_script.voiceover: Telling an LLM to write bold, empathetic, and premium copy gives you identical fluff to every competitor in your category.
reel_script.direction: Text overlay showing bad prompt example alongside Rachit.

reel_script.voiceover: Constraint one: Set a strict sentence length limit. Force sentences under twelve words. AI defaults to compound sentences when unconstrained.
reel_script.direction: Rachit holding up one finger, talking to camera.

reel_script.voiceover: Constraint two: Ban passive verbs and buzzwords explicitly. List the exact words your brand never uses.
reel_script.direction: Rachit gesturing to text list appearing on screen.

reel_script.voiceover: Constraint three: Mandate a mechanism or a number for every claim. Require it to flag claims that lack concrete proof.
Prompting is not creative writing. It is setting guardrails that stop the model from defaulting to average internet copy.

reel_script.voiceover: Send this to the brand manager on your team who is building your prompt library this week.

caption:
Why most AI prompts for marketing produce generic copy, and the three negative constraints that fix it.

When you tell an LLM to sound premium, accessible, and authoritative, it averages those concepts across its training data. The result is copy that sounds like every B2B website built after 2023.

Instead of instructing tone, set structural boundaries:

1. Cap sentence length at 12 words to eliminate run-on phrasing.
2. Provide an explicit list of forbidden category buzzwords.
3. Require every claim to include a specific number or named mechanism.

Prompting is not creative writing. It is quality control.

Send this to the marketer on your team writing your AI prompt workflows.
